title: library fabrication step schema
description: One step that made the piece: what was done, on which tool, and the lab's own record of it, verbatim. After NeXus NXhistory/NXactivity and the CHADA (CWA 17815) workflow stage.

step.description: Order of the step, counting from 1

process.description: What was done, e.g. sputter deposition, anneal, lithography

tool.description: The lab's name for the tool, e.g. pdac_com5

produces.description: What the step produced, e.g. the AlScN film

record.description: The lab's own record of the step, in the lab's format, unchanged

source.description: Where the record came from, e.g. a file name or a photograph of the label
